notes.content: The continuing opening paragraph calls compatibility an important additional relation on M alongside the two indexed order relations. “Moralement”, these data recover l’atelier up to unique isomorphism, qualified in the slanted margin by “au moins dans le cas modéré”. The page proposes F parallel G for disjunction (1.14), and a vertically divided diamond or opposed zigzags for compatibility (1.15), retaining canceled trials. An open oval surrounds the latter alternative. The NB compares speed of writing and combinatorial suggestiveness, with an extra angular sign of uncertain live/canceled state. The lower paragraph calls the live preccurlyeq relation “de raffinement”, describes it as “formellement de nature plus délicate” and the most specific notion in the “Algèbre des figures”, and begins a sentence on geometric meaning, examples and axioms that continues off the page.
math_reading_decisions: The centered M labels are undersets. M’s typographic alphabet is marked uncertain at its first occurrence; the special family F keeps calligraphic/fraktur alternatives.
Both live opposed-zigzag compatibility signs have four free diagonal ends; H’s closed-hourglass description is not followed. The canceled trial remains ambiguous between the proposed signs.

The canceled predecessor of the lower preccurlyeq is ll. The live word raffinement is not corrected to subdivision: the earlier local notation record and H’s editorial note motivate care but cannot change the ink. This is a comparison of transcribed signs and words, not a mathematical proof check.
The extra NB sign is reproduced from its visible angular strokes with explicit live/canceled alternatives. No unseen predecessor is inferred.
No closing parenthesis is supplied for the opening (NB, and no continuation is supplied after the uncertain final hyphen.
author_doubts: “au moins dans le cas modéré” qualifies that assertion.
“On n’a rien dit pour l’instant au sujet de la relation …” marks a topic not yet discussed; it is not an explicit request for verification.
No à vérifier, sauf erreur, question mark on an argument, or other explicit verification demand appears.
notes.titles_dates_counts: Manuscript page 9, scan 010; displays (1.14) and (1.15). “Algèbre des figures” is quoted in the body with paired raised strokes, not a separate heading. One underline marks compatibilité. The enclosing oval is reproduced in TikZ. No date, total page count, archive pencil sheet number, arrow diagram, additional footer or other hand was observed by the readers.
